title: Filipino Vegan Fried Rice
description: A vegan adaptation of the popular Filipino dish, using plant-based ingredients to replicate the classic flavors.
instructions: Heat melted vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the imitation shrimp and cook until lightly browned.
Add the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and vegan oyster sauce. Stir to combine.
Add the fried rice to the skillet or wok and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Optional: Add other vegetables, such as diced bell peppers or sliced mushrooms, to the skillet or wok with the onion and garlic for added flavor and nutrition.
Optional: Use a combination of vegetable broth and water to achieve the desired consistency for the fried rice.
Optional: Omit the vegan oyster sauce for a simpler flavor profile or substitute with another umami-rich ingredient, such as miso paste or mushroom broth.
